Over de functie 
As a hotel cleaning staff member, you ensure that hotel guests always stay in a fresh and tidy room. You change bed linen, replenish towels and amenities, and check each room for cleanliness and any issues. You typically work between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM, on Sundays from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, mainly on the busier days from Thursday to Sunday. Sometimes, you can work extra on Mondays and Tuesdays if it's busy. Together with your colleagues, you prepare rooms, discuss any special details, and help each other when needed. The work is physically demanding, so you are often on the move, but your workplace is always clean and tidy.
